searchText: to be more precise, in the following cases, we don't charge the account write for authority - is `tx.sender`, covered by `TX_BASE_COST`; - was written by a preceding valid authorization; - is `tx.to` of a value-bearing transaction, covered by `TX_VALUE_COST`; Hi all! I am starting to clean up the repricing EIPs. But before finishing it, I wanted to understand what to do with https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11891 Should we merge this before, <@830368514225340436> and <@402853454126776320> ? Yes Yup. I think this PR has some good clarifications that are helpful to implementers Thank you, merging now <@402853454126776320> , now that we are processing 7702 authorizations in the pre-execution phase, as described in 2780, can I remove all that counter logic described in 8037 (the Gas accounting for EIP-7702 authorizations section)? [Here](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11906) is the PR with the EIP clean-ups. Should be merged shortly
